rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion narrow and doctrinally orthodox, applying Arbaugh/Hamer’s clear-statement rule to hold § 7703(b)(1)(A) nonjurisdictional while leaving tolling details for remand. A Thomas dissent is most likely (with possible Alito join or separate dissent) pressing Bowles, CSRA structure, and historical practice, while one or more majority concurrences may emphasize limits on equitable tolling or the proper reading of Bowles/Henderson.
